plan.summary:
Snapshots are now identified by a `SnapshotKey` (project-scoped) instead of a bare `Uuid`. The same PR also changes two boundary behaviors.

- `stale` returns `SnapshotKey` values and now treats entries with `expires <= now` as stale (was `<`).
- `shouldFlush` now returns true when `force` is set, even with no pending items.
plan.riskRationale: The stale return type is a contract change. The expiry boundary change and the new force flush path both change behavior. No tests are in the diff.
plan.storyArc: The PR title names the key change. The first topic covers that key change and the expiry boundary shift in `stale`. The second topic covers the separate `force` flag in `shouldFlush`. The two topics are independent.

topics.title: Key stale snapshots by SnapshotKey and expire at the boundary
topics.narrativeBrief: What does `stale` return now, and which entries count as stale? Verify that callers accept `SnapshotKey`. Note that the `<` to `<=` change is a behavior change beyond the re-keying.

topics.title: Let force flush even with nothing pending
topics.narrativeBrief: When does `shouldFlush` return true now? The `force` argument now makes it return true even when `pending` is empty. Check how callers set `force`. The PR description does not mention this change.
